style.backgroundSystem: flat #BFE0F0 field screens, solid #1F5C8B block screens and clean #FFFFFF screens alternating screen by screen; one frosted rounded overlay card at 78 percent opacity sits on the single photographic scene screen; leaf shadows and a liquid pour arc are the only ambient decoration
style.direction: clean clinical pet dairy nutrition detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line glyphs seated inside dashed circles in #1F5C8B or #8A8F98, sun and droplet marks in #F2C14E, small double-quote marks and short dash rules under headings, hairline rules in #1F5C8B
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight, front-left key at 5500K with bounce fill, gentle falloff, low contrast, soft contact shadows that ground every item, controlled highlight on pack shoulders, never hard speculars and never floating products
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-dairy ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of field #BFE0F0, block #1F5C8B, card #FFFFFF, surface #F2F3F5 and one sun accent #F2C14E with charcoal text #2D2D2D and icon grey #8A8F98; cool tone throughout; one modern geometric rounded sans-serif family, Chinese display headlines in #1F5C8B with a thin #FFFFFF outline on #BFE0F0 and #1F5C8B fields and in #2D2D2D on #FFFFFF; layout system of pill sub-banners, one short dash rule under every heading, hairline rules in #1F5C8B and one frosted rounded overlay card at 78 percent opacity; icon system of single-weight thin-line glyphs inside dashed circles in #1F5C8B and #8A8F98 with sun and droplet marks in #F2C14E; soft diffused daylight with a front-left key at 5500K, bounce fill, low contrast and soft contact shadows only; backgrounds alternate between #FFFFFF, #BFE0F0 and #1F5C8B; marble-veined and matte plinth surfaces in #F2F3F5; packaging held upright at one consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, grounded by a contact shadow, animals generic and cropped; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm cartoon drift, no medical iconography.
noDrift: no warm cartoon or hand-drawn drift
no medical iconography such as crosses, shields or organ diagrams
no QR codes or membership badges
style.presentationRules: packaging always upright at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, one unit per screen except the grid and comparison screens, contact shadow mandatory, cap and seal edge readable, never restyled or cropped at the label panel, animals always generic and cropped so no individual identity reads
style.surfaceSystem: round marble-veined display pedestal top in #F2F3F5, shallow matte discs and low plinths in #F2F3F5, weathered timber rail for the pasture screen, glossy #FFFFFF beakers and bowls for the pour and macro screens
style.typography: one modern geometric rounded sans-serif family; Chinese display headlines 30-46pt in #1F5C8B with a thin #FFFFFF outline on #BFE0F0 and #1F5C8B fields and in #2D2D2D on #FFFFFF; pill sub-banners 16-20pt; labels 14-18pt; every visible string is a placeholder, no dense body copy
